description: The Vancouver local areas, streets, blocks and directory years AddressLore covers: every directory year read with names (each area's extra years said), the years read for the whole city, the later years that hold buildings and places only, and the census years, with each local area's count of streets and addresses and its page. Ask again with area for that area's streets, each with its blocks, its own years and its page.

area.description: A City of Vancouver local area as listed in areas ("Strathcona", or its slug "strathcona"): lists its streets.

page.description: Which page, when an answer says it has more than one (pages, next_page); 1 if left out.

name: coverage
title: What AddressLore covers
